envelope.description: Bridge native review CLI execution and binary resolution

body.title: Bridge native review CLI execution and binary resolution
body.summary: Integrate the review-worker bridge with src/shared/process-group.ts and src/agent/providers/cli-provider.ts. Route supported native CLI session spawn/output/cancellation through main-host leases while keeping model selection and structured-output parsing in the worker. Remove the review-worker resolveBin synchronous which spawn by host-supplied/asynchronously bridged resolution. Deliver and validate the CLI adapter with bound real-worker fixtures in this task; bootstrap installation, registered host-service connection and public-route activation are owned by t7, t8 and t14 respectively.
acceptanceChecks: Within the CLI adapter exercised by a bound real review worker, no native CLI starts without a host lease and durable intent receipt; cancellation and actual worker termination leave disposal with the surviving host owner. An unbound review-role worker fails before binary lookup or local spawn. Production bootstrap/registry installation is verified in t7/t8 and all supported public routes cut over in t14.
CLI stream bytes use bounded backpressure and owner-scoped cancellation; structured response and model/tool activity parsing remain in the review worker.
Review binary lookup cannot execute execFileSync which in the worker; non-review callers keep current behavior and supported reviewer/provider selection is unchanged.
Fake CLI fixtures cover spawn failure, observer failure, cancellation, late output and worker loss without cloud calls or direct REST access.

tests.name: src/agent/providers/__tests__/review-worker-process.test.ts: fake native review CLI streams and cancellation use host-owned leases
src/agent/providers/__tests__/review-worker-process.test.ts: review binary lookup cannot spawn synchronously on the worker
